findings.title: Invalid XML sitemap
findings.evidence: Sitemap at https://www.failblog.org/sitemap.xml could not be parsed as valid XML.

suggested_action.detail: Validate your sitemap against the standard XML schema.

findings.title: No date signals found
findings.evidence: No <time> tags or JSON-LD date properties were found.

suggested_action.detail: Use standard schema.org datePublished/dateModified and HTML5 <time> elements so AI knows the freshness of the content.

findings.title: Missing H1 heading
findings.evidence: No <h1> tag or role='heading' (aria-level=1) was found on the page.

suggested_action.summary: Add a single, clear H1 heading
suggested_action.detail: Ensure the page has one main H1 heading that describes the primary content for AI summarization.

proactive_recommendations.title: Publish an AI Policy / Terms of Service
proactive_recommendations.rationale: If you block some AI bots in robots.txt to protect IP, explicitly state what is allowed in a `/ai-policy` page. This ensures bots that respect advanced directives handle your content correctly.
proactive_recommendations.suggested_action: Add an AI Terms page and use <meta name="robots" content="noai"> if needed, rather than blanket disallows.
